criteria.requirement: it must not require a selected track, load audio, instantiate Mapper, or make any network request
criteria.action: With no track selected and network/audio calls instrumented, click fixture-btn and inspect the initialized scene.
criteria.expected: A fixture starts with one canvas, nine named box cells, and zero network, audio-load, or Mapper-construction calls. (Tolerance: Exact object counts and names; zero forbidden calls.)

criteria.requirement: For every cell compute `v` from its feature and set `scale.y=h=0.5+2*v`, `position.y=h/2`, and leave `scale.x=scale.z=1`.
criteria.action: Call window.fixtureViz.setTime(0.5), then inspect every cell transform and fixture-root rotation.
criteria.expected: Heights are [1,1.5,2,1.5,2,1,2,1,1.5], each position.y is half its height, x/z scales are 1, and rotationY is PI/8. (Tolerance: 1e-6 for all numeric values.)

criteria.action: Set times 1.5 and 3 and inspect the root transform and final-frame heights.
criteria.expected: Rotation is 3PI/8 at 1.5 and 3PI/4 at 3; at 3 heights are [0.9,1.3,1.7,1.3,1.7,0.9,1.7,0.9,1.3]. (Tolerance: 1e-6 for all numeric values.)

criteria.requirement: it must throw `TypeError` without changing time or the scene
criteria.action: Set time to 1.25, snapshot getState and transforms, then call setTime with NaN, Infinity, undefined, and a string.
criteria.expected: Every invalid call throws TypeError and the time, heights, cell transforms, and root rotation remain unchanged. (Tolerance: Exact state equality after each rejected call.)

criteria.requirement: Repeated `play()` calls while already playing must not create additional animation loops.
criteria.action: Use a controlled monotonic clock, call play twice, advance by 0.5 seconds, pause, advance the clock again, and inspect time.
criteria.expected: Time advances exactly 0.5 seconds rather than doubling, and remains fixed after pause. (Tolerance: 1e-6 seconds.)

criteria.requirement: Rerunning via `fixture-btn` must leave exactly one fixture canvas and nine fixture cells.
criteria.action: Advance the fixture, click fixture-btn again, and inspect the DOM, scene, state, and old instance cleanup.
criteria.expected: One canvas and nine cells remain, the new state is time 0, and the prior instance has no active animation loop. (Tolerance: Exact counts and time 0 within 1e-6.)

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the initial rendered 3D scene and its declared state. Inspect task-relevant depth and geometry across at least three views where appropriate, and inspect composition, materials, lighting, color, and legibility.
Exercise the central interaction and numeric or geometry contract through the visible UI. Verify meaningful scene/state feedback without inventing unrequested controls.
Repeat the boundary, invalid-input, recovery, and reset sequence while inspecting live scene state.
Inspect 1440x900 and 390x844 layouts, including lower controls and keyboard focus. Reload and inspect console/resource diagnostics.
